verdict.rationale: Orb documents migration from Stripe Billing (including flat-rate, usage-based, seat pricing) and backfilling historical usage events for accurate invoicing, which supports competing-platform migration. However there is no evidence of spreadsheet-based import tooling, PCI-compliant card/payment-method data transfer, or explicit assurances that migration is seamless enough that customers won't notice. Missing for 10: spreadsheet import support, PCI-compliant card data transfer mechanism, and documentation/testimony of zero customer disruption during migration.
